import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static int n, k, mod;
    static int[][] f;
    static int[] fac, inv, ifac;
    static final int N = 250001;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        mod = sc.nextInt();

        inv = new int[N];
        fac = new int[N];
        ifac = new int[N];
        f = new int[N + 1][27];

        inv[1] = 1;
        fac[0] = 1;
        fac[1] = 1;
        ifac[0] = 1;
        ifac[1] = 1;

        for (int i = 2; i < N; i++) {
            inv[i] = (int)((long)mod / i * (mod - inv[mod % i]) % mod);
            fac[i] = (int)((long)fac[i - 1] * i % mod);
            ifac[i] = (int)((long)ifac[i - 1] * inv[i] % mod);
        }

        long ans = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            ans = (ans * k) % mod;
        }

        if (n % 2 == 0) {
            f[0][0] = 1;
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                if ((n & i) == i) { // subset enumeration
                    int msk = i - lbit(i);
                    for (int j = msk; ; j = (j - 1) & msk) {
                        int len = Math.min(k - 1, Integer.bitCount(j));
                        for (int t = 0; t <= len; t++) {
                            f[i][t + 1] = (int)((f[i][t + 1] + (long)f[j][t] * ifac[i - j]) % mod);
                        }
                        if (j == 0) break;
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
                long temp = ((long)f[n][i] * fac[n]) % mod;
                temp = (temp * fac[k]) % mod;
                temp = (temp * ifac[k - i]) % mod;
                ans = (ans - temp + mod) % mod;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }

    static int lbit(int i) {
        return i & -i;
    }
}
